name: Stats Band
description: The homepage's five figures. Mobile is the frame that matters: at 390px the band drops to two columns of 195px, and 48px of side padding left 99px of each for a 44px figure like 8,500+ that needs about 150. A grid track's automatic minimum is its own content, so it could not shrink - the band pushed the whole page into a sideways scroll, with the second column sliced off at the screen edge. The fix is a smaller figure and gutter at phone width plus a track allowed to shrink. Nobody had seen this: until the navigation stopped rendering every dropdown open, no band below the header was visible at this width at all.
